question: What range of reality should be encompassed when meditating on that in every place?
premises: Meditation is to be done in every place.
The object of meditation is that.
Its range extends from Shiva down to Avici.
inference: One should meditate on that in every place as extending from Shiva to Avici.
plain_english: Having meditated on that in every place, one should see it as extending from Shiva down to Avici.
